title: After-School Pickup Geofence Gaps
dataSources: Baby feedings (`baby:feed`), baby sleep (`baby:sleep`), diaper changes (`diaper:change`), school departures (`school:departure`), stroller activity (`stroller:walk`), household chores (`chore:event`), and family geofence events (`family:location`).
app: Family and baby telemetry from baby-tracking apps, school and geofence automations, stroller logs, chore trackers, and shared-home events streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and Home Assistant.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=family:location event="pickup"
| stats avg(arrival_gap_min) as avg_arrival_gap_min max(arrival_gap_min) as max_arrival_gap_min by child location
| sort - max_arrival_gap_min
description: Measures the time gap between the expected and actual family pickup geofence events.
value: Pickup timing issues are low-drama until they are not, and this metric helps you improve reliability before a true miss happens.
implementation: Send pickup geofence events with an expected-versus-actual arrival gap from your family location automation.
visualization: Table of average and worst pickup gap by child and location.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces how far off family pickups are from the planned time, so late handoffs show up clearly.
